verdict.rationale: Mercado Pago documents fast account opening ('in minutes'), no-code payment links shareable anywhere, a hosted Checkout Pro page with guest payment, and a Checkout API that receives card data. Together these plausibly let a founder accept online card payments soon after signup, but nothing confirms that card acceptance is live within a day. Missing for 10: evidence of time-to-first-live-card-payment (verification/activation delays), explicit confirmation that payment links accept cards immediately, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can accept an online card payment within a day of signing up

citations.quote: Abrí tu cuenta en minutos desde el celular.
